name: Bodica
found: South Fields, at the marsh-edge stone after slaughter.
appearance: 80s. Toothless. Shawl stinking of pig offal.
sayings: They let us be. Don't give them a reason.
wants: Her grandson out of the southern marsh.
oddly_also: Leaves slaughter offal on a flat stone by the marsh. It's gone by morning.
knows: Lizard-men have always watched the south fields at night.
dm_notes: She does it deliberately. Her mother kept the stone before her. The lizard-men know it, and know her.
campaign_notes: Created 2026-10-07 in the Nemetra NPC quality test; drawn from Drive 'Nemetra Gnoll Threat'.
